name: Motor Power Calculator
description: Calculate electric motor shaft power from electrical power input and motor efficiency, or convert between kW and HP.

seo.title: Motor Power Calculator - kW to HP Converter
seo.description: Calculate motor power requirements from torque and speed — Select proper motor sizing for applications

formula.explanation: Shaft power output P_out = P_in × η. P_in converted from kW to W by engine; /1000 returns result in kW. η is efficiency as decimal (0-1).

content.introduction: Calculate the actual mechanical shaft power delivered by an electric motor given its electrical input power and efficiency. Essential for motor sizing and pump/fan drive calculations.

example.description: A 22 kW motor operating at 90% efficiency delivers 19.8 kW of shaft power.

faq.a: IE3 premium efficiency motors typically achieve 88-96% depending on size. Smaller motors are less efficient than larger ones.

faq.q: How do I convert kW to HP?
faq.a: 1 HP = 0.7457 kW. Divide kW by 0.7457 to get HP.
